description: This is a shell script containing test cases for 'git rebase --merge --skip' functionality. It sets up a git repository, performs various rebase operations including skipping commits, and verifies expected behaviors and outputs.

methods.name: test_expect_success
methods.description: Defines a test case expecting success; executes a command sequence.

methods.name: test_must_fail
methods.description: Runs a command expecting it to fail; used to verify error handling.

methods.name: test_path_is_missing
methods.description: Checks that a specific file or directory is absent.

methods.name: test_cmp
methods.description: Compares files or output against expected results.

methods.name: test_when_finished
methods.description: Ensures cleanup commands are run after tests.

methods.name: set_fake_editor
methods.description: Sets up a fake editor environment for testing rebase interactions.

methods.name: test_editor_unchanged
methods.description: Verifies that editor environment variables remain unchanged after tests.
